criteria.reason: register/login are intentionally public endpoints; no owned-resource read/mutation in this story. Excluded.

JWT set with httpOnly + sameSite=lax + secure-in-production; password stored/compared via bcrypt (cost 10); tightened validation (email format, 8-char min, username format+uniqueness) present in register; JWT algorithm is the library default (HS256), never 'none'.
All user lookups use Sequelize where-clause objects; no raw/interpolated SQL.
JWT secret read from process.env (JWT_SECRET ?? JWT_KEY); bcrypt used for hashing; nothing hardcoded.
Errors are mapped to the Conduit envelope (no stack traces to the client); no permissive CORS introduced; cookie carries httpOnly/sameSite.
No follow/favorite/comment business logic in this story. Excluded.
Every handler wraps its logic in try/catch and returns a mapped error envelope via statusFor/toErrorResponse — no raw exception or internal message leaks to the client.

note: 5 of 7 criteria applicable, all 1.0; SEC-01/06 N/A excluded. securityVulnerabilitiesAllowed=0 respected.
